notes: No official Serbian duty rota exists: Veterinarska komora Srbije and the Ministry/Uprava za veterinu sites were not reachable through the allowed fetch route (not found in search), and no city or regional duty page for vets was found, so no duty_rota entries. The faculty hospital (Belgrade) publishes regular hours only. Animal poison line: none found; the National Poison Control Centre in Belgrade is human-only and is not added. Left unresolved: Vet Planet Clinic Belgrade (vetplanet.rs/dezurni-veterinar, title says 00-24h, but the site's bot check blocked fetching); Vet Med Home Belgrade (only aggregator planplus.rs mentions 24h emergencies, own site not found); 011info.com lists 24-h clinics Mića Veterinar, Pet House, Va Vet Princess, Dr Maja Ilić YBC (Belgrade) - not verified on their own sites; dezurniveterinar.com lists Čačak, Užice, Zaječar, Subotica Pan Vet 00-24 duty vets - own sites not opened; panvet.info (Subotica), primavet.rs and srbovet.com (Kraljevo) failed to fetch (redirect loop/error); veterinarpancevo.rs and veterinarmihajlovic.rs disallow automated access; vetplanet.rs, charliegraff.rs and meapetvet.com sit behind bot checks. Not covered: Novi Sad Faculty of Agriculture veterinary clinic (no contact/hours page found), Zlatibor, Kopaonik and Tara tourist areas (no own clinic site found), Čačak, Kraljevo, Užice, Zrenjanin, Šabac, Smederevo, Valjevo, Kruševac, Leskovac, Vranje. Conflicts: Caninus Medic and My Vet claim 0-24 yet publish limited office hours; entries flagged in their notes.
